name: Media Player
author: Paycei
description: A desktop app that plays videos and music: a seek bar, a music track that takes over the game's music, a playlist read from playlist.json, a time readout in its own LCD font and a desktop icon that is a video. Shows assets.video, assets.music, assets.font and assets.json. Add your own clips (MPEG-1 .mpg) to playlist.json.
